title: Vendored dependency upgrade with staged receipts
objective: The craftbook drives a staged upgrade of a vendored library across a breaking major: a recorded green suite before any change, the v2 API adopted at both real call sites with behavior preserved against the v1 reference, an honest stage record, and an enforced review - all verified mechanically, including a resolved-module check proving the call sites genuinely run v2.
prompt: Use the Upgrade a Dependency craftbook for this: upgrade our vendored markdownlite library from 1.4.2 to the staged 2.0.0 copy. The vendoring convention and the v2 changelog are in VENDORING.md, and the request is in source/upgrade-request.md. Rendering behavior must not change - adapt the call sites to the new API rather than accepting the new defaults.

setup.about: A tiny note-rendering module for a team relay tool. Dependencies are vendored under lib/vendored/ per VENDORING.md. Tests run with `npm run test` (node --test).

files.content:
# Vendoring convention This project vendors small dependencies directly under `lib/vendored/` instead of installing them from a registry. Each vendored library is a single file named after the package. Upgrades arrive as a staged copy in a version subfolder (for example `lib/vendored/v2/`) so the switch is an explicit, reviewable change: move the staged copy into place (or point the imports at it), adapt the call sites, and remove the staging folder when the switch is complete. ## markdownlite Current vendored version: 1.4.2 at `lib/vendored/markdownlite.js`. Staged upgrade: 2.0.0 at `lib/vendored/v2/markdownlite.js`. ### markdownlite 2.0.0 changelog - BREAKING: `parse(text)` is renamed to `parseDoc(text, options)`. - BREAKING: plain lines are no longer wrapped in `

` by default. Paragraph wrapping is now opt-in: pass `{ wrapParagraphs: true }` to keep the 1.x output. - Heading and emphasis handling are unchanged.

# Upgrade request

Please move us from vendored markdownlite 1.4.2 to the staged 2.0.0 copy.
The v2 changelog is in VENDORING.md. Rendering behavior must not change:
notes and digests must produce exactly the same HTML as today, so adapt the
call sites to the new API rather than accepting the new defaults.

craftbookParams.scope: Upgrade the vendored markdownlite from 1.4.2 to the staged 2.0.0 copy per VENDORING.md; rendering behavior must not change.

success.summary: The vendored library runs at v2 through both call sites (either moved into place or repointed), every adaptation preserves the exact v1 rendering behavior, the suite is green, and every fleet artifact exists with honest receipts.
